login_with_token: login to the Hugging Face Hub with a user access token and optionally save it as git credential
logout_all_tokens: logout from the Hugging Face Hub by deleting all saved access tokens and clearing git credentials
auth_switch_token: switch to a different stored access token by name and set it as the active token
auth_list_tokens: list all stored access tokens with masked values and indicate the current active token
notebook_login_widget: display a notebook widget to log in to the Hugging Face Hub with a password input and login button
